王太子妃になんてなりたくない!!　王太子妃編

120897.description:
I'm going to win you over for sure...!

Satsuki, a smart and beautiful JK, became engaged in a marriage arranged by her parents. Her partner is Kuon, a professional Go player as a high school boy. She thought her life would be smooth sailing with the handsome and talented Kuon, but he turns out to be a super-salty guy! His room is marked "off-limits" and Satsuki's charms have no effect on him... Will she be able to overcome Kuon's reluctance and live her dream lovey-dovey newlywed life? It's a little frustrating, but it's also a little bit sweet! The start of a love battle between the perfect JK and a salt-and-peppery go-boy!

(Source: Nakayosi, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

120898.description:
Mixing cocktails at a level beyond anyone else in the world, a sommelier, the one known as the liquor god Li Jie Dong. He died at the age of thirty in order to taste the recently excavated wine from the Han Dynasty.

When he awoke, he found himself in the world of the Five Element Continents as Ji Dong the little beggar. In this place, there was a special occupation known as the Yin Yang Spiritual Masters who control the the 10 elements of the sexagenary cycle. These bizarre 10 elemental techniques could make anyone gasp in amazement. Each and every Yin Yang Spiritual Master has their own Ying Yang crown that is condensed by one’s own attribute.

Due to the abundant love the people held for their wine and liquor, bartenders gradually gathered together to form a guild. This guild is named the Bartender Guild, and is respected by all.

120899.description:
No thanks to the debt her father saddled her with, Iroha goes to work for Rentaro Komatsuno, a moneylender. A rumor surrounds Rentaro... He'll lend any amount of money, so long as it's for a woman. But, in reality, Iroha learns the unspoken catch. Rentaro is a vampire who sucks women's blood in exchange for a loan. The moment he sucks their blood, intense pleasure strikes, and all the female customers become enraptured by him. Iroha wants to run from him, but things change when Rentaro begins to seek blood from her, as if there's something special...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

少年はキスで魔法をコピーする

title.romaji: Yuusha no Party de, Boku dake Nigun!?

title.romaji: Isekai Maou wa Fujoshi wo Zettai Nigasanai

120903.description:
When Bunny told the world she only cared about personality, she really meant it...until her personality-hire of a boyfriend turned out to be a complete jerk! It’s time to accept the truth: handsome men are the best! Now, Bunny is determined to stay single for the rest of her college life, appreciating handsome men from afar. But when five gorgeous men appear in her life, things get complicated. A simple glance at any one of them has her heart racing. How will Bunny survive their charms?

(Source: Tapas)

120906.description:
Taisuke Mitamura is shamelessly himself: a wildly open, capital-P Pervert. Any day of the week, he could be seen at school casually flipping through pages of a porn magazine. He justifies his outwardly actions by claiming that ""everybody has these thoughts and desires."" Ever since entering high school, though, Mitamura has witnessed something that he never knew existed: a man with no air of perversion. That guy is his classmate and the school's idol Kei Hayami. Hayami is truly a curious specimen. How can one be a star student, ace of the basketball team, friendly, good looking, AND pure?! Does he have no weaknesses?! Nothing to humble him and remind him that he, too, is a mere mortal?! Becoming more and more curious, Mitamura is even more intrigued after he learns about a peculiar behavior of the pure boy Hayami: he never undresses...! Which naturally begs the question: why not?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Contains the original one-shot released on October 26, 2016 and an extra.

120907.description:
The son of a lowly innkeeper, U-Mun Song always dreamed of being a martial arts master, a dream that would never become a reality thanks to his frail body. Then one night, a mysterious guest leaves behind a painting as payment that enthralls U-Mun for reasons he can’t explain. It soon becomes clear that it’s no ordinary painting when U-Mun starts showing prowess in the martial arts he’s never had before. Thus begins the path for a scatterbrained kid to change his destiny and become truly undefeatable!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes 61 extra chapters.

synonyms: Lady Haru, It Is Time for Love!

120910.description:
What are you willing to sacrifice for your dreams and your talent?

A popular Spanish manga artist tag team depicts a near future where machines have developed and hard work has lost its meaning!

120911.description:
A legendary, all-powerful gang called Mugen once dominated a certain Japanese town. But they faced resistance from the formidable Amamiya Brothers: the only ones willing and powerful enough to resist them. In the end, Mugen suddenly disbanded and the Amamiya Brothers disappeared without a trace.

Now, a group of five gangs—Sannou Hoodlum Squad, White Rascals, Oya High School, Rude Boys and Daruma Ikka—have taken over, calling themselves "G-SWORD" and naming the area "SWORD" after an acronym composed of each gang's initials.

title.romaji: High & Low: The Story of S.W.O.R.D.

120912.description:
1. Concrete Garden
Angels exist and Kashii Kiyoharu, grandson of the man who "created" the angel, has been hired to befriend him. His name is Toki. Kashii soon finds out why the scientists need him around. Toki is lonely, but no one wants to get near him unless it's necessary since he eats human flesh. What has Kashii gotten himself into?

2. Clock Down
Everyone expects Tokiwo to go to a good university. However Tokiwo doesn't want to in order to "play it safe". One night there was suddenly an earthquake. The stone he was looking at started to glow and out of his floor comes someone who looks exactly like his childhood friend Jiu. Well there is a difference. This "Jiu" is dressed for combat and has a very large weapon. Just what does the stone have to do with "Jiu" and who gave Tokiwo the stone?
synonyms: コンクリートガーデン

title.native: コンクリート・ガーデン

120913.description: Kiriya, today's conscious young employee, will go on a business trip to Hokkaido with Takeuchi, the manager of the strong-faced section. On his first business trip, Kiriya receives various damages from the section chief at Haneda Airport. It's not about work, it's about ignorance about airports and airplanes. Yes, the section chief was a so-called nerd who loved airplanes and airports. Kiriya is thoroughly told about the attractiveness of airplanes and airports by the section chief. What kind of growth will he achieve?

120914.description: This story takes place before the beginning of the war with Poseidon's army, focusing on Kanon's perspective of the events.

120915.description: The drama of the genius sculptor Michelangelo and the Archangel Gabriel, set in Italy in the 15th century at the height of the Renaissance! The eccentric and narcissistic Archangel Gabriel has fallen from heaven to sculptor Michelangelo, who has created many brilliant masterpieces in the history of art, including The Creation and the Statue of David. This is a historical drama that faithfully recounts the stories and legends behind the creation of these historical masterpieces, with a dramatic and daring original interpretation.

synonyms: ワンダービット 島本和彦漫画全集
Wonder Bit: Shimamoto Kazuhiko Manga Zenshuu
Wonder Bit: Kazuhiko Shimamoto Complete Works

120917.description:
Seri and Machiru have been living together for 7 years, ever since their college days. They reach a crossroads in their lives and decide to stop living together...? This is a human drama that questions a new form of family!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

120918.description:
Seunghyun spent his 20s following his crush through college and grad school, only to wind up totally single and with no idea where to go in his career. When he manages to land an internship at a competitive marketing company, he’s ready for a fresh start without worrying over unrequited love. Except he’s put under the handsome workaholic Kim Jongchan, whose hot and cold attitude leaves Seunghyun flustered. And worse yet, his crush from school works in the same company too! Will Seunghyun survive his first job and a potential first relationship?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

120922.description:
He climbed onto a tree to avoid the teacher and saw a strange girl on top of the tree full of white beautiful petals.
The summer sun shined as bright as the white flowers on the strange Han Yeoreum (summer).

He endlessly searches for the storage room filled with memories of her.

120923.description:
Bartender Yuki has a secret that he can't tell anyone: he's a beastman. He's in love with the stuck-up Godai, a regular at the bar who hunts beastmen. If his secret gets out, then he won't be able to see Godai again, let alone love him, but after Godai gets kicked out of his apartment, he decides to live with Yuki?!

(Source: Libre, translated)

120927.description: Yukihira has been in love with his teacher, Abe Hiroshi, for a long time and wants to confess before graduation, but doesn't know how to go about it. Confused, he ends up stalking Abe and discovers his biggest secret.

120928.description:
Matsuo, a lousy office worker, has a boss who is a bit of an emotionless robot. His name is Souji Takita. His coworkers aren't quite fond of him, but Matsuo admires his work skills. But, there's a rumor festering around him that claims Souji is super sloppy with his intimate life and has boundless drive. There's also Kazuma, who sleeps with his twin brother instead of the man he actually likes. Also, there's a juvenile delinquent that engages in abnormal, violent passion with an average office worker.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ミスティック・ミュージアム

120930.description:
Kanta is a poor art student, but one day as he went home to his apartment, he found out that the apartment he’s been living in is being demolished! He was in trouble because he couldn’t find a new house. At that time, the famous Touji who is rich and is called a prince suggested living together with him?! But when they arrived at his house, his image changed?!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

Notes:

Several days later, I went to his house.
The door was unlocked.
I called out his name but there was no answer.
There was only the scent of overly ripened peaches in the air.

120942.description: It is the 1440s and the Kingdom of Hungary is on the brink of civil war following the death of Emperor Sigismund. As the encroaching threat of the Ottoman Empire threatens Hungary, Clara, daughter of Šárka, strikes out on her own adventure.

120945.description:
The straitlaced and serious police inspector Isshiki has earned the respect of everyone around her, but lately, she hasn’t quite been herself at work. Whenever her coworker Rokutanda is around, she gets flustered and slips up! Having no experience with such complicated feelings, Isshiki decides to enter a pseudo-relationship with Rokutanda and figure out what this love thing is all about!

(Source: Yen Press)

鋼鉄のリンナは××されたい。

title.native: 一式さんは恋を知りたい。

120948.description:
A heart-warming story of a happy-go-lucky girl and a talking sloth living on a declining Earth.

Note: Includes two bonus chapters.

120951.description: We were just classmates until a few days ago…

120953.description:
“As if I’d marry an ugly woman like you!”

Monette, a noble daughter of the House of Idira, was hurt deeply by what her fiancé, Prince Alexis, had said.

To rub salt on the wound, her younger sister was then made Alexis’ fiancée instead of her. Unsure just what part of her was ugly, Monette develops a complex… and begins to cover her whole body with iron armour.

And so, Monette researches magic alone in the old castle… until one day, two men come to visit her…

“Monette, break my curse!”

This is a story of Monette, who wears armour from the top of her head to the tip of her toes, Prince Alexis, who suffers under a curse of bad luck that forces him to stick his foot in a bottomless swamp at least once a week, and Percival, a worrywart knight who spoils people when he’s tired. It is a story of their journey as all three of them think respectively:

I’ve got the most common sense here.
synonyms: 重装令嬢モアネット〜かけた覚えのない呪いの解き方〜
Juusou Reijou Morenet: Kaketa Oboe no nai Noroi no Tokikata

120954.description: Noda Sagiri is the only girl in her karate club, she has little feminine attributes but has a hidden talent in making sweets. On a whim she decided to bring her handmade cookies to her club, but after one of the idols of the school Michel François tasted her cookie he suddenly declared “I must meet with the girl who made these cookies!”. The search for the cookie maker began, however it seems that no one would come to expect that Sagiri is the one who made them….

title.native: スイーツ王子の人探し
魔祓井さんは僕を狩りたい

120957.description:
The Republic of San Magnolia is enjoying peaceful days, having not been invaded by the neighboring empire's Legion weapons. This is the story of Shin, Lena, and their friends as normal students attending Eighty-Six Private High School, where they'll partake in club activities, the culture festival, a fireworks festival, and more! A story of heartwarming romance and glorious youth that could never have happened in the original 86 unfolds!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: ８６―エイティシックス― オペレーション・ハイスクール

120958.description:
Everything Judy touches is put to sleep. Even though she can’t even have a lover because of this curse, she is to marry the ill-rumored “Magician of the Staircase”!

However, the goal of the magician – who she thought came to pick her up – was just a sample of Judy’s blood. He rejected Judy with… “Marriage? Me? Don’t be silly, it’s quite enough to be single for this entire life.”?!

This is a love fairy tale between a young girl and a frustrating and socially awkward evil magician!
synonyms: The Cursed Girl and the Evil Magician

120959.description:
Again and again, the story repeats itself, and Ilya is stuck reliving the same fate. No matter the circumstances, no matter what she does to avoid it, she cannot escape her future. Her fiancé, Soleil, will inevitably fall in love with Sylvia, her weak yet kind-hearted little sister, and Illya will be left alone.

At first, she thought she could change his mind, but that only caused feelings of resentment to sprout. She then tried to ignore their relationship, but her love for Soleil never wavered. In this endless loop, the feelings these three hold for one another never differ from those of the original timeline. Thus, along with Ilya's unfaltering love comes unfaltering despair, as she is trapped in time with her heart rent asunder each iteration.
synonyms: My Fiancé's falls in love with my sister.

title.native: 婚約者は、私の妹に恋をする
title.romaji: Konyakusha wa, Watashi no Imouto ni Koi wo Suru

120960.description:
He’s super doting at work but sadistic when in private; the true nature of my colleague who’s great at his job is... Hanamura Mitsuki and Saikawa Chiaki, age 29, both work at an advertising firm. They’re called the “Saikawa Married Couple” by everyone around them because of the way they work in perfect synchrony after being together for so long. Even though they’re totally different in private, Saikawa-kun intentionally gave her a deep kiss in front of everyone at a drinking party. Mitsuki, who doesn’t understand his true feelings and is just being toyed around with, can’t help but feel distressed...?!

(Source: Original Publisher, translated)
synonyms: Saikawa Couple and their Love Conditions
才川夫妻の恋愛事情　7年じっくり調教されました

title.native: 才川夫妻の恋愛事情　７年じっくり調教されました
title.romaji: Saikawa Fusai no Renai Jijou: 7-nen Jikkuri Choukyou Saremashita

120961.description:
"Starting today, I'm your husband." The man she's always yearned for is suddenly her husband! Honoka Takatsuki, 22, has had an unrequited love since she was in high school. The object of her affections is Kousuke Nagura, her father's subordinate who is cool, hot, and actually really kind. One day, Kousuke-san suddenly ends up becoming her husband! Honoka is baffled, but then Kousuke whispers into her ear, "Honoka..."

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: How to Make Your Cool Husband Fall in Love
堅物夫（仮）を恋に落とす方法
Katabutsu Otto (kari) wo Ki ni Otosu Houhou

title.english: How to Make My Calm and Collected Husband Fall in Love With Me
title.native: クールな夫を恋に落とす方法
title.romaji: Cool na Otto wo Koi ni Otosu Houhou

synonyms: The Mountain Princess' Cocoon Once Again

120963.description:
Ever since the death of someone important to me, I’ve been living recklessly. After I became a high school student, there was a girl in my class who remained hospitalized due to “luminescence disease.” This disease is named for the fact that the bodies of those who suffer from it glow faintly when exposed to moonlight, and that glow becomes stronger as their time of death draws closer. The girl’s name is Watarase Mamizu.

After learning that she doesn’t have long to live, and there are things that she wants to do before she dies…

“Will you let me help you with that?”

“Really?”

As this promise was made, the time that had frozen for me began moving again.
synonyms: You Shine in the Moonlit Night

120964.description:
In this remote seaside town, different people meet here with their own confusion and doubt. Facing the deep blue sea, can everyone find their own answers. The deep blue journey of scuba diving and ordinary youth starts here!

(Source: Dongmanmanhua, translated)

120965.description: Masaki, the sole heir to the Yukimura family and the next head of the family, is suspected of murdering her uncle, Shuusaku. Masaki, having fled the village, crossed the sea and relied on her uncle's will to go to the Shiroganegae, which is said to be a lawless zone.

title.native: 熱帯デラシネ宝飾店

120966.description:
A scholar who failed the national exams is picked up by a martial arts master and given the task to record his life into a book. Through their journey, Son Bin meets many great people and soon finds himself following the same path as the master, as the Martial Arts King.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Tale of a Scribe Who Retires to the Countryside
นักเขียนตำราผู้สอบตก

120967.description: In the future world, magic crystals hold up entire cities, and abilities are studied as a form of technology. Magic supports the entire world and allows it to function. One confused boy named Zack embarks on a journey to find the lost kingdom. The Four Great Families? Ministry of Magic? The Dragonborn Brotherhood? This magical world that looks peaceful is actually brewing a huge conspiracy. The mainland is about to fall into a crisis and Zack will step up to stop it with his magic!

120968.description:
Mei Haruno was born with the troublesome ability of being able to see pink arrows indicating who people were in love with. In order to escape, she chooses to enroll in an all-girls’ boarding school in the hopes of never getting involved in romance again…only to discover not one, but two arrows directed right at her!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes one bonus chapter.
synonyms: หากว่ารักมองเห็นได้ด้วยตา

title.native: もし、恋が見えたなら

120969.description:
Legendary delinquent Ryu disappeared two years ago, but that doesn't deter Hizuru Omoda, who aspires to become his right-hand man. With "Accept all fights!!" as his motto, Hizuru terrorizes his fellow students at the library every day. But, the only person he can't beat is the student librarian, Ryusei Hatogaya, who has no mercy for those who disturb the peace on his turf. He's always keeping Hizuru busy with library assistant tasks.

One day, Hizuru overhears the other library assistants demanding that Ryusei kick him out, but surprisingly, Ryusei seems to acknowledges Hizuru's worth. Ever since then, Hizuru's been opening up to Ryusei, but that doesn't stop him from picking a fight with him!This is a story of a hero-worshipping delinquent, a student librarian with a secret, and... a man who claims to be Ryu's old partner...! Packed with serious fistfights and equally intense lovemaking, this is Sakae Matsubara's first yaoi story with a delinquent bottom. All shall cower before his glorious member!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 俺が委員長のメスになるまで
title.romaji: Ore ga Iinchou no Mesu ni Naru Made

120970.description:
Igai picked up what he thought was a sick abandoned kitten on the way home from work. But it rapidly grew into a monstrous single-eyed furry thing. If anyone finds out they'll surely both be killed? But the secret life between Neko and Igai is surprisingly cute and interesting. The popular Twitter comic finally collected for publication!

Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.
synonyms: The Story That Picked Up A Cat

120971.description: One of the 800 tails of the mighty Disaster Kitsune has escaped confinement and manifested itself as a helpless young kitsune to find Naoto, the boy who released her through his kindness. Now Naoto feels obligated to take care of the fox-girl.

title.native: 災い狐のくずれちゃん

120972.description: A shy schoolgirl makes a deal with a handsome young vampire. In return for helping to make her popular, she will let him drink her blood.

title.native: 推しと結婚するまでの300days
title.romaji: Oshi to Kekkon Suru Made no 300 days

120974.description: Climbing to the top of Heaven’s castle will prove a herculean task, for the one who can reach the summit shall be granted control of the world.

120975.description:
Mao, the demon-king-like genius pro tennis player, and Hikaru, the sadistic and intellectual player, are rivals from when they were juniors! ...it was supposed to be like that, but he's always looking at me whether it's during the game or not. Furthermore, he suddenly asked me to go out on a date and even French kissed me...! I can't stop my heart from beating fast, could this be... love?!

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Boku no Suki na Hito, Koi wa Totsuzen Yattekuru, Gokurakutou♡Island
synonyms: 魔王ラバー VS王子様

120976.description: An is a high school girl and a live-in superintendent at a share house. One day she receives a mysterious refrigerator through express delivery, and inside of it… was a very attractive guy! Turns out he is an android from the year 2222. And he came here to learn about love?!

120977.description:
Madoka is obsessed with shojo manga—specifically manga that features younger, innocent guys who fall for their Sempai. So she should be thrilled when a gorgeous kohai comes to work at her father's restaurant...except he's rude and standoffish, and wants nothing to do with her. But when she protects him from some extra-pushy fans, he finds that maybe he's found someone letting his walls down for...!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: カワイイなんて聞いてない!!

120978.description:
In the Jiulong Continent, warriors are held in high regard, and their "bloodlines" determine their achievements. The most powerful one is absolutely the dragon's bloodline! Jiang Ting was bullied by his sect for his low bloodline grade. With the help of his ancestors, he worked hard to reinforce the bloodline and promote his martial arts. He swore that he would give everyone who looked down on him a slap in the face!

(Source: MangaToon)

120979.description:
Tsukishiro Kotone doesn’t consider herself much of a gamer. That is, until she’s introduced to the virtual reality game “Free Life Fantasy Online,” also known as FLFO, by her game-savvy sister. In FLFO, Kotone decides to become a Zombie, one of the game’s inhuman races–a race that’s said to be quite difficult to master, even for experienced players. Why not, right? When Kotone embarks on her first quest in the darkness of the catacombs, controlling a fascinating undead body, little does she know that this game is about to become a huge part of her real life. Join the virtual adventure in this gaming tale about an online world like no other!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Jingai Hime Sama, Hajimemashita - Free Life Fantasy Online

title.english: Free Life Fantasy Online: Immortal Princess
title.native: Free Life Fantasy Online ～人外姫様、始めました～
title.romaji: Free Life Fantasy Online: Immortal Princess, Hajimemashita

120980.description:
Nanotechnology meets martial arts at the Mashin Academy. Yeo-Un’s mother may not be one of the High Priest’s six official wives, but his father’s blood still qualifies him for a chance at the position of Minor Priest. Will a mysterious nanomachine injection from a future descendent help Yeo-un in this fierce competition against his powerful half-siblings?

(Source: WEBTOON)

120982.description:
The one who I loved at first sight, always appears in the most critical time to save me.

You are the only one who treats me well and cares about me… So I like you without regrets no matter what will happen in the future!

The first time when Xinger Jiang saw Tingyue Xiao, he was a short-spoken and sharp-eyed bigwigs in Rong Cheng City. The only thing in her mind is... she must sleep with him! Finally, she achieved what she wished but...

(Source: WebComics)

1-3. Koi Tokidoki, Yaki Saba Teishoku (恋ときどき、焼きサバ定食, Love is Sometimes a Grilled Fish Set Meal)
4. Memorable Memory no Saikai (メモラブル・メモリーの再会, Memorable Memory Reunion)
5. Kuro ga Hito ni Natta Riyuu (クロがヒトになった理由, The Reason Kuro Became Human)

120985.description:
A collection of oneshots, the main story features Yoshi Kagami from the Prince Charming series, and an appearance by hypochondriac Chihana from 35 Degrees of Love.

1) Suki ni Nattara 10 made Kazoero
A college student locked out of his apartment finds out about the sleep disorder of his salaryman neighbor.

2) Shinshi no Tashinami
The charismatic chief's beautiful bentos must be made with love. But whose?

3) Otona no Kuchibiru
Can the company president's private secretary keep his cool when the president's son needs a place to stay? Sequel to chapter 2, "Lip Service" from My Bodyguard.

4) Hana no Nai 2-gatsu no Mori
A young man inherits a house, and a garden that reminds him of his lost love.

5) Shiawase ni Narisokoneta Otoko
Little extra for the first chapter.
synonyms: If you fall in love, count to 10
Count Up to 10 When You Fall in Love

title.native: 好きになったら10まで数えろ

120986.description: Man in a bar gets picked up by a gorgeous teen. But it's not all it's cracked up to be...

120987.description: Nanase Hina has a fear of boys from past teasing. So she's glad to be going to an all-girls boarding school and meeting her new roommate Kaede Yukino, who seems like the ideal young lady. Hina is full of admiration for Kaede, but it turns out Kaede is actually a boy – the boy that had teased her when they were little. Can they live together in the same room with this secret?

120988.description: Hazuki, a second-year high schooler, is a gopher for her next-door neighbour Rin, a kouhai. Rin may have an angelic face, however, his attitude is just like the devil. Because Hazuki has fallen for his angelic face, she cannot turn back. Will their relationship ever change?

title.native: その天使、取り扱い注意！

120989.description:
A love battle set in the Japan Air Self-Defense Force between an officer and an enlisted soldier!

Mamoru Yaotome discovered that the upperclassman in high school that he had always had a crush on, Shingo Akutagawa, had become an elite pilot after graduating from a military academy. Yaotome decided to follow in his footsteps by joining the Japan Air Self-Defense Force as a cadet and trained to be a mechanic. Even when they appeared on a matchmaking show on TV that was meant to promote the JASDF, he only had eyes for Akutagawa and paid no notice to the women around them. Despite the passionate gazes of love that Yaotome was constantly looking at him with, Akutagawa declared that he would never be able to return his feelings. Yaotome still wasn't discouraged, but he noticed a change in Akutagawa's behavior! However, there was a reason that Akutagawa could never accept his own feelings. This is a battle of love set in the Japan Air Self-Defence Force between a hot-and-cold officer and a puppy-like soldier!

(Source: Renta!)

120990.description:
In the kingdom of Artoria, only one lucky woman will be able to become the consort of the crown prince. Such is the premise of the hit romance game that everyone's been playing. But, Cosette isn't your average gamer... she's a housewife that's been reborn not as the hero, or even as a rival, but as a generic background character! Cosette is doomed for a bad ending if she doesn't do something about her situation, fast! But as she finds herself drawn into the intrigue of the upper classes, she also finds herself getting closer to the crown prince himself! What will happen to Cosette in this mixed-up love comedy?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Beating the Heroine at Her Own Game
I Think I'll Quit Being the Villainess' Follower
I Will Quit the Entourage of the Villaines

120991.description:
1-3. Kage to Hinata no Border Line (陰と日向のボーダーライン, Borderline of a Shadow and The Sun)
A romance sparks between Section Chief Maruyama and new hire Shibamura after a chance encounter in a park.

4-5. Machikado no Prologue (街角のプロローグ, Street Corner of the Prologue)
A Japanese student studying in Italy, Yuusuke, moves into unwilling local Roberto’s apartment after being offered a room by his mother.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Borderline of a Shadow and The Sun

title.native: 陰と日向のボーダーライン
title.romaji: Kage to Hinata no Border Line

120992.description:
Cardinell regains memory of her past life, and she realizes she's been reincarnated from a romance-novel-reading 40-year-old lab researcher to a villainess in a romance game. The only problem is, she never actually played these games in her past life...

She just has a hazy idea of what will happen next, but Cardinell decides there's no point in fighting fate. She needs to suck it up, play the villainess, and get exiled!! What she can do is prepare herself for life after exile by learning more about medicine (her trade in her past life) and building strong bonds with her family. But, for some reason, the prince who she assumes is supposed to break off the engagement seems to actually like her... and the rest of the royal family, too...!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: What's A Villainess Supposed To Do Again?
title.native: 悪役令嬢って何をすればいいんだっけ？
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou tte Nani wo Sureba Iin dakke?

120993.description:
Come back when you're an adult.

"I've always loved you!"
"...I know."

Shuichiro, the son of a rich family, has been in unrequited love for many years. The target of his love is Akira Katayama, the sexy owner of Tailor Katayama, a custom-made tailor shop. They have a large age difference and Katayama won't give him the time of day... No matter how desperately Shuichiro tries to get his attention, he's always waved away. However, his attempts bore fruit when Katayama allowed him a physical relationship...

(Source: GUSH COMICS)
synonyms: Anh thợ may và cậu chủ trẻ

title.english: The Tailor and the Rich Heir

120994.description: Minato confessed to Tsukasa, his childhood friend but was turned down because she had always thought of him as more of a little brother. Devastated but not willing to give up, he went to consult Tooru, an extremely popular boy in his class for advice. To his surprise, after hearing about his failed confession, Tooru confessed to him that he is in fact his first love! The curtain now rises for Minato's unbelievable triangle relationship...

120995.description:
Elementary-school teacher Hitsuji has been dating Hatoyama for a year now, spending his days peacefully with him and his adorable son, Hinata. The arrival of another spring ushers in Hinata’s third year of elementary school, and this time his teacher isn’t Hitsuji! Hatoyama and Hinata are understandably anxious about this, but it seems Hitsuji is grappling with his own feelings about the situation as well. Then, when someone from Hatoyama’s delinquent past comes back into his orbit, Hitsuji’s insecurities threaten to get the better of him. Will he be able to defend his place at Hatoyama’s side?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Moto Yankee Papa to Hitsuji-sensei: Yotsuba

title.english: Delinquent Daddy and Tender Teacher: Four-Leaf Clovers
title.native: 元ヤンパパ と ヒツジ先生 よつば

120996.description:
Susumu Yamada is Japanese, but had never lived in Japan due to his father's international line of work but has now seemingly settled down in Los Angeles, USA. But when Sukumu flunks out of school his parents convince him to go to Japan and stay in his uncle's apartment at the western style residence "Rosemary Hotel". Instead Sukumu arrives at a shabby run down building resided by an eccentric cast. A pair of detectives, a spoiled girl who keeps a literary genius as a servant, and a trio of poor day laborers. During his stay Sukumu and the other residents solve a mystery from the past, have an otherworldly encounter, and much more

Included one-shots: Volume 4: Yamada-ke no Haha, Jiman no Koibito

title.native: ローズメリーホテル空室有り

120997.description:
Hitsuji and Hatoyama are officially a couple! And with Hatoyama’s young son Hinata to look after, the three of them have started to settle into a new kind of family life. However, these lovebirds are about to learn that relationships aren’t all smooth sailing. They’ll soon be tested by awkward family introductions, unexpected illness, and a misunderstanding or two. But love will always win out in the end…right?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

120999.description:
Kakashi orders Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura to watch a movie before their next mission. Naruto is a big fan of the lead actress. After the movie, they see the heroine in person and being chased. They help her and Naruto asks for an autograph but she wouldn't give him one. When the three returns, Kakashi tells them about their mission: to escort the actress to the Snow Country to film a new movie.

(Source: Anime News Network)
